outline.description:
Formalises tools common throughout the work: policies regarded as autoregressive generative models whose outputs are treated probabilistically; query–response pairs driven by verifiers providing scalar rewards.
Highlights how rewards are normalised relative to groups so advantages drive optimisation.

outline.description:
Summarises classic PPO mechanics—token‐level clipping keeping updates proximal to old policy—and preliminarily notes dependence on reliable value estimates that bloat cost.
Sets context handy when later contrasting term‐wise versus sequence‐wise objectives.
subtopics:

outline.description:
Describes how GRP drops value models by comparing scores acquired against several replies produced per query.
Shows how an advance score is normalised over generated replies while retaining per‑token weighting.
